open-pdf-get-page-count.title: Open PDF and Verify Page Count
open-pdf-get-page-count.description: Shows how to open a PDF file using Aspose.Pdf, retrieve the total page count, and perform a basic verification that the document contains pages.

open-pdf-from-filestream-and-save-copy.title: Open PDF from FileStream and Save Copy
open-pdf-from-filestream-and-save-copy.description: Demonstrates how to open a PDF document using a FileStream with Aspose.Pdf and save it to another file using the default PDF settings.

open-encrypted-pdf-without-password.title: Handle InvalidPasswordException When Opening a PDF
open-encrypted-pdf-without-password.description: Demonstrates how to attempt opening a password‑protected PDF with Aspose.Pdf without providing a password and catch the resulting InvalidPasswordException.

save-pdf-to-memorystream-and-write-to-fi.title: Save PDF via MemoryStream to File
save-pdf-to-memorystream-and-write-to-fi.description: Loads an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf, saves it into a MemoryStream, then writes the stream contents to a new output file.

convert-pdf-to-pdfa1b.title: Convert PDF to PDF/A-1b with Metadata Preservation
convert-pdf-to-pdfa1b.description: Demonstrates converting an existing PDF to PDF/A-1b compliance using Aspose.Pdf, preserving document metadata and optionally generating a conversion log.

encrypt-pdf-with-owner-user-passwords.title: Encrypt PDF with Passwords and Restrict Printing
encrypt-pdf-with-owner-user-passwords.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, applying user and owner passwords, restricting printing by setting permissions, and saving the encrypted document.

decrypt-encrypted-pdf.title: Decrypt PDF with User Password using Aspose.Pdf
decrypt-encrypted-pdf.description: Shows how to open an encrypted PDF by supplying the user password, remove its encryption, and save the resulting unprotected file.

add-blank-page-to-pdf.title: Add Blank Page to PDF
add-blank-page-to-pdf.description: Shows how to load an existing PDF, append a new blank page, and save the modified document using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-pdf-page-into-another-pdf.title: Insert PDF Page into Another PDF at Specific Position
insert-pdf-page-into-another-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load two PDF documents with Aspose.Pdf, extract a page from the source PDF, and insert it into a target PDF at a given 1‑based position, then save the result.

remove-third-page-from-pdf.title: Remove Third Page from PDF
remove-third-page-from-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, delete the third page when present, and save the modified document.

split-multi-page-pdf-into-single-page-fi.title: Split PDF into Single-Page Files
split-multi-page-pdf-into-single-page-fi.description: Loads a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterates over each page, creates a new document for each page, adds the page, and saves it as an individual PDF file.

batch-convert-pdfs-to-pdfa-1b.title: Batch Convert PDFs to PDF/A‑1b
batch-convert-pdfs-to-pdfa-1b.description: Shows how to iterate over PDF files in a folder, convert each to PDF/A‑1b compliance with Aspose.Pdf, and save the converted files to an output directory.

encrypt-pdf-stream.title: Encrypt PDF from Stream and Save to Stream
encrypt-pdf-stream.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF from an input stream, applying AES‑256 encryption with user/owner passwords and specific permissions, and writing the secured PDF back to an output stream.

create-pdfx3-document-three-pages.title: Create PDF/X‑3 Document with Three Pages
create-pdfx3-document-three-pages.description: Demonstrates how to create a new PDF, add three blank pages, convert it to PDF/X‑3 format with a conversion log, and save the result.

update-pdf-title-metadata.title: Update PDF Title Metadata from Byte Array
update-pdf-title-metadata.description: Shows how to load a PDF from a byte array, modify its Title metadata, and save the updated document to disk using Aspose.Pdf.

incremental-append-page-to-pdf.title: Save PDF with Incremental Update to Append Pages
incremental-append-page-to-pdf.description: Shows how to copy an existing PDF, open it with a read/write FileStream, append pages from another PDF, and save using Aspose.Pdf's incremental update mode.

compress-pdf-default-settings.title: Compress PDF Using Default Settings
compress-pdf-default-settings.description: Loads a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, saves it without explicit compression options (using default compression), and reports the original and compressed file sizes.

export-pdf-pages-to-separate-files.title: Export PDF Pages to Separate Files
export-pdf-pages-to-separate-files.description: Shows how to split a PDF into individual page PDFs by iterating over each page with Aspose.Pdf and saving each page as its own document.

load-pdf-memorystream-set-version-save.title: Load PDF from MemoryStream, Convert to Version 1.4, and Save
load-pdf-memorystream-set-version-save.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF from a MemoryStream, converting it to PDF version 1.4 using Aspose.Pdf, and saving the resulting file to disk.

encrypt-pdf-form-filling-permission.title: Encrypt PDF with Form Filling Permission Only
encrypt-pdf-form-filling-permission.description: Shows how to encrypt a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, allowing only form filling (ModifyContent) and disabling content extraction and other actions.

create-pdfa1b-with-text-paragraph.title: Create PDF/A‑1b Document with Text Paragraph
create-pdfa1b-with-text-paragraph.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF, add a text paragraph to the first page, and convert it to PDF/A‑1b compliance using Aspose.Pdf.

rotate-second-pdf-page-90-degrees.title: Rotate Second Page of PDF by 90 Degrees
rotate-second-pdf-page-90-degrees.description: Demonstrates how to open a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, verify the presence of a second page, rotate that page 90 degrees clockwise, and save the modified document.

update-pdf-author-metadata.title: Update PDF Author Metadata Using Aspose.Pdf
update-pdf-author-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to open a PDF file, modify its Author metadata, and save the changes back to the original file using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-encrypt-pdfs-in-directory.title: Batch Encrypt PDFs with Password
batch-encrypt-pdfs-in-directory.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt every PDF in a folder using a user and owner password, and save the encrypted files to a separate output directory.

batch-decrypt-encrypted-pdfs.title: Decrypt Multiple PDFs Using Owner Password
batch-decrypt-encrypted-pdfs.description: Demonstrates opening encrypted PDF files with a shared owner password, removing their encryption, and saving unprotected copies to a designated output folder.

convert-pdf-to-pdfa-1b.title: Convert PDF to PDF/A-1b with Aspose.Pdf
convert-pdf-to-pdfa-1b.description: Shows how to load a PDF, convert it to PDF/A‑1b compliance while preserving the original structure and embedded fonts, and save the resulting file.

download-pdf-from-url-and-save.title: Download PDF from URL and Save Locally with Aspose.Pdf
download-pdf-from-url-and-save.description: Demonstrates how to fetch a PDF file from a network URL using a WebRequest, load it into an Aspose.Pdf Document from a stream, and save it to the local file system.

encrypt-pdf-aes256-no-print.title: Encrypt PDF with AES-256 and No Printing Permission
encrypt-pdf-aes256-no-print.description: The example encrypts a PDF using AES‑256 with user and owner passwords, disables all permissions including printing, and then verifies the encryption and permission settings.

update-pdf-version-to-1-5-incremental-sa.title: Change PDF Version and Apply Incremental Update
update-pdf-version-to-1-5-incremental-sa.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, converting it to version 1.5 using Aspose.Pdf, and then saving it with an incremental update by reopening the file with a read/write stream.

update-pdf-passwords.title: Change User Password of Encrypted PDF
update-pdf-passwords.description: Demonstrates opening a password‑protected PDF, re‑encrypting it with a new user password while preserving the owner password and permissions, and saving the updated file.

split-pdf-at-page-10.title: Split PDF into Two Parts at Page Ten
split-pdf-at-page-10.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, split it into two documents at page 10, and save each part with descriptive filenames.

set-pdf-document-title-and-verify.title: Set PDF Document Title and Verify
set-pdf-document-title-and-verify.description: Demonstrates how to open a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, set the document's Title metadata, save the file, and then reopen it to confirm the title was persisted.

convert-pdf-to-pdfx3-cmyk.title: Convert PDF to PDF/X-3 with CMYK Color Spaces
convert-pdf-to-pdfx3-cmyk.description: Loads an existing PDF, converts it to PDF/X‑3 format to meet PDF/X‑3 compliance (including CMYK color space conversion), and saves the result as a new PDF file.

batch-convert-pdfs-to-pdfa-with-csv-repo.title: Batch Convert PDFs to PDF/A-1b with CSV Log
batch-convert-pdfs-to-pdfa-with-csv-repo.description: Demonstrates iterating over PDF files in a folder, converting each to PDF/A‑1b using Aspose.Pdf, and logging the conversion result to a CSV file.

rotate-pdf-page-3-180-degrees.title: Rotate Third Page of PDF from Byte Array
rotate-pdf-page-3-180-degrees.description: Shows how to load a PDF from a byte array, rotate the third page by 180 degrees, and save the updated document.

encrypt-pdf-with-user-password-only.title: Encrypt PDF with User Password and Restricted Permissions
encrypt-pdf-with-user-password-only.description: Shows how to encrypt a PDF using Aspose.Pdf by applying a user password, allowing only printing while disabling editing and content extraction.

encrypt-pdf-allow-form-filling.title: Encrypt PDF Allowing Only Form Filling
encrypt-pdf-allow-form-filling.description: Demonstrates opening a PDF, applying AES‑256 encryption with permissions that restrict the document to form‑filling only, and saving the encrypted file.

split-pdf-into-individual-pages.title: Split PDF into Individual Page PDFs in Separate Folders
split-pdf-into-individual-pages.description: Shows how to open a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through each page, create a new single‑page document, and save each page as a separate PDF inside its own folder.

encrypt-pdf-rc4-128-verify-size.title: Encrypt PDF with 128‑bit RC4 and Verify Size Increase
encrypt-pdf-rc4-128-verify-size.description: Shows how to encrypt an existing PDF using 128‑bit RC4 encryption with Aspose.Pdf and then confirms that the encrypted file is slightly larger than the original.

batch-encrypt-pdfs.title: Batch PDF Encryption with Configurable Passwords
batch-encrypt-pdfs.description: The example reads a JSON configuration file that defines multiple encryption jobs, encrypts each PDF using Aspose.Pdf with specified user and owner passwords, and logs success or error messages.

convert-pdf-to-pdfx3-preserve-icc.title: Convert PDF to PDF/X‑3 with ICC Profile Preservation
convert-pdf-to-pdfx3-preserve-icc.description: Shows how to load a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, convert it to PDF/X‑3 while retaining existing ICC color profiles, and save the converted file.

batch-convert-pdf-to-pdfa-with-report.title: Batch Convert PDFs to PDF/A‑1b with Compression
batch-convert-pdf-to-pdfa-with-report.description: Demonstrates processing a folder of PDF files, applying resource optimization, converting each document to PDF/A‑1b format, and creating a CSV summary report of the conversion results.

add-custom-xmp-metadata-to-pdf.title: Add Custom XMP Metadata to PDF
add-custom-xmp-metadata-to-pdf.description: Loads a PDF file, inserts a custom XMP metadata entry, and saves the document while preserving all existing metadata.

encrypt-pdf-owner-password-only.title: Encrypt PDF with Owner Password Only
encrypt-pdf-owner-password-only.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt a PDF using only an owner password, granting full rights to the owner while restricting all permissions for regular users.

rotate-all-pdf-pages-180-degrees.title: Rotate All PDF Pages 180 Degrees
rotate-all-pdf-pages-180-degrees.description: Demonstrates opening a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, rotating each page by 180 degrees, and saving the result to a new file.

encrypt-pdf-aes128-verify-print-permissi.title: Encrypt PDF with AES‑128 and Verify Print Permission
encrypt-pdf-aes128-verify-print-permissi.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt a PDF using AES‑128, restrict permissions to high‑quality printing, and verify the encryption and permission settings.

batch-encrypt-pdfs-with-deterministic-pa.title: Batch Encrypt PDFs with File‑Name Based Passwords
batch-encrypt-pdfs-with-deterministic-pa.description: Shows how to encrypt multiple PDF files using Aspose.Pdf, generating a unique password from each file name and writing the passwords to a secure log.

batch-split-pdf-by-page-ranges.title: Split PDF into Sections by Page Ranges
batch-split-pdf-by-page-ranges.description: Demonstrates how to read page‑range definitions from a text file and create separate PDF files for each range using Aspose.Pdf.

encrypt-pdf-form-fill-permission.title: Encrypt PDF with User Password and Form-Fill Permission
encrypt-pdf-form-fill-permission.description: Shows how to encrypt a PDF using user and owner passwords, allow only form filling, and disable printing with Aspose.Pdf.

set-pdf-metadata-author-title-subject.title: Set PDF Document Metadata (Author, Title, Subject)
set-pdf-metadata-author-title-subject.description: Opens an existing PDF, assigns author, title, and subject information, saves the file, and then reopens it to verify the metadata values.

encrypt-pdf-rc4-no-copy-permission.title: Encrypt PDF with RC4 and Verify Permissions
encrypt-pdf-rc4-no-copy-permission.description: Shows how to encrypt a PDF using RC4 (128‑bit) with restricted copying, programmatically check the security settings, and optionally decrypt the document.

convert-pdf-to-pdfa1b-with-font-embeddin.title: Convert PDF to PDF/A‑1b with Embedded Fonts
convert-pdf-to-pdfa1b-with-font-embeddin.description: Shows how to load a PDF, convert it to PDF/A‑1b compliance (embedding any missing fonts), and save the resulting archival‑ready file using Aspose.Pdf.

disable-font-embedding-when-saving-pdf.title: Disable Font Embedding in PDF and Save
disable-font-embedding-when-saving-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF, turn off font embedding using optimization options, and save the resulting document.

compress-pdf-high-optimization.title: Save PDF with High Compression and Compare File Size
compress-pdf-high-optimization.description: Demonstrates applying high‑level compression to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's OptimizationOptions, saving the optimized document, and comparing its size with a default‑saved PDF.

update-pdf-author-metadata__v2.title: Update PDF Author Metadata
update-pdf-author-metadata__v2.description: Loads a PDF file, sets its Author metadata to the current user name, and saves the updated document.

convert-pdf-to-pdfa-1b__v2.title: Convert PDF to PDF/A-1b Compliance
convert-pdf-to-pdfa-1b__v2.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, convert it to PDF/A‑1b compliance while generating a conversion log, and save the compliant document.
